critical_code_review_comments: portal_routes.py voice-transcribe shares the same _rate_guard bucket as BIFF and guided-journey. Running the iter222 rate-limit test burns 41 slots from parent1's IP for 1h and also blocks BIFF from the same IP until the window rolls. Iter220 review already flagged this — please split guided-journey/voice into their own buckets or lower _PER_IP_LIMIT specifically for voice.

GuidedJourneyModal mic button uses onMouseLeave={recording ? stopRecording : undefined} — when a parent drags off the button while holding, the recorder stops and an empty/partial webm may POST. Add a min-duration guard (e.g. skip upload if blob.size < 2KB) so parents don't hit /voice-transcribe with 0-byte payloads.

portal_routes._sanitize_guided_drafts mutates the incoming snapshot dict in place (history/answers truncation) before serializing for the byte-cap check. Harmless today but fragile — construct a shallow copy first.

SacoparentsPortal.jsx is now ~1794 lines (was 1710 last iter). The extract-a-hook feedback from iter220 review is now more urgent — useGuidedJourney, usePortalShare, and useDraftSync should live in separate hooks.

AlignmentHub 'Guided chat' pill is 9px font on a 390-wide viewport — meets tap-target minimum by being 20px tall but the text contrast (purple-800 on white/80) is borderline for parents with low-vision. Consider bumping to 10px + semi-bold weight.

GuidedJourneyModal shows 'Voice input isn't supported' style error only via guided-error-{topic}, but the error state persists until the next successful send. If the parent taps mic again and it works, the previous error banner remains visible. Minor UX polish (auto-dismiss on next recording start).
